desc: The guided farm tutorial (state: Save.d.tutorial.ft = {step, done, skipped}). Short, skippable, one prompt at a time. Every owner-confirmable choice is under 'options' so it is a one-line change.
options_doc: tracker_replaces_day1: the top-right card is the Goals tracker. player_swing: E near a site swings a hammer (one swing per swing_cooldown_s), so one Boki is enough. end_gems: the one reward at the end (the old +5 each and +30). house_first: the other steps wait until the house is down. strict_order: true makes every step wait for the one before. skippable: Tab on the prompt asks to skip.

hints.place: Press {build}, pick House, then click the marked spot
hints.wait: Your Boki are building it. Watch, or press {interact} at the house to swing a hammer too

hints.place: Press {build} and set the trough down
hints.fill: Walk up to the trough and press {interact} to fill it from your pantry

hints.patch: Press {build} and put a crop patch down
hints.plant: Plant a seed in the patch ({interact})
hints.grow: Give it a moment to grow, then pick it

hints.go: Walk up to your Boki and press {interact}
Hob draws up more buildings. Walk up and press {interact}
Ready? Step into the portal ({interact}) for your first expedition

tracker.title: Goals
tracker.per_source_doc: At most this many rows from each source, so the top five are not all Hunter challenges. Order inside a source: closest to done first; ready-to-claim rows lead everything.
